title: Késésfigyelő v3
summary: Real-time Budapest transit delay tracker: GTFS-RT feeds collected every minute on the Cloudflare free tier — Workers, D1, KV, R2, zero maintenance cost.

title: Bar Project
summary: Interactive 3D bar visualisation built for a computer graphics course — WebGL, custom shaders and procedural geometry.

title: Personal site ecosystem
summary: armands.blog · armands.cv · armands.site — three Hugo sites with a unified Monokai design system, single-source CV data, CI-built PDFs and a shared contact pipeline (Cloudflare Worker + Zoho Mail + Turnstile).

title: Neumann archive
summary: The 2013–14 IKEA “At Home in the Forest” competition site, resurrected: a WordPress 3.8.5 + WPML install frozen into a fully static, maintenance-free archive — original design pixel-for-pixel, galleries, quizzes, panoramas and a frozen Twitter feed all working.

title: Vivace
summary: Single-tenant, config-as-code status page — one status.yml, one SQLite database, one static frontend. Same core, two thin adapters: Cloudflare Workers (cron + D1) or plain Node.js (built-in scheduler + node:sqlite). No accounts, no admin UI.

title: Homelab Kubernetes cluster
summary: Self-hosted k3s cluster with GitOps continuous delivery — every service declared in Git, deployed automatically by Argo CD.

title: Self-hosted GitLab
summary: Private GitLab instance running the family's repositories, CI runners and container registry — independent of external SaaS.

title: Cloudflare Tunnel ingress
summary: All homelab services exposed securely through Cloudflare Tunnels — no open ports, no public IP exposure, Access policies on top.
